title: Leveraged positions on decentralized lending platforms
abstract: arXiv:2601.14005v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We develop a mathematical framework to optimize leveraged staking ("loopy") strategies in Decentralized Finance (DeFi), in which a staked asset is supplied as collateral, the underlying is borrowed and re-staked, and the loop can be repeated across multiple lending markets. Exploiting the fact that DeFi borrow rates are deterministic functions of pool utilization, we reduce the multi-market problem to a convex allocation problem and obtain closed-form solutions under three interest-rate models: linear, kinked, and adaptive (Morpho's AdaptiveCurveIRM). The framework incorporates market-specific leverage limits, utilization-dependent borrowing costs, and transaction fees. Backtests on the Ethereum and Base blockchains using the largest Morpho wstETH/WETH markets (from January 1 to April 1, 2025) show that rebalanced leveraged positions can reach up to 6.2% APY versus 3.1% for unleveraged staking, with strong dependence on position size

translated_title: 去中心化借贷平台上的杠杆头寸
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一个数学框架，用于优化去中心化金融（DeFi）中的杠杆质押（“循环”）策略，其中质押资产作为抵押品，借入标的资产并重新质押，该循环可在多个借贷市场中重复进行。利用DeFi借贷利率是资金池利用率的确定性函数这一事实，我们将多市场问题简化为凸分配问题，并在三种利率模型（线性、分段线性和自适应（Morpho的AdaptiveCurveIRM））下获得闭式解。该框架包含特定市场的杠杆限制、依赖利用率的借贷成本和交易费用。在以太坊和Base区块链上，使用最大的Morpho wstETH/WETH市场（2025年1月1日至4月1日）进行的回测显示，重新平衡的杠杆头寸年化收益率可达6.2%，而非杠杆质押为3.1%，且强烈依赖于头寸规模。
tldr: 本文提出一个数学优化框架，用于DeFi中的杠杆质押策略，在多种利率模型下获得闭式解，并通过回测证明该策略可将年化收益率提升至非杠杆的两倍以上。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a mathematical optimization framework for leveraged staking strategies in DeFi, obtaining closed-form solutions under multiple interest-rate models and showing via backtests that the strategy can more than double APY compared to unleveraged staking.
